CELEBRATING EXCELLENCE & ACHIEVEMENT :

Our students have brought immense pride to Anandaram Dhekial Phookan College (ADP College) by securing Top Positions in Gauhati University in the 2023–26 Batch.
A heartfelt congratulations to UO DARPANA BAISHYA NCC Cadet & a student of 5th sem of our college for attending the All India Thal Sainik Camp (AITSC) 2025, held from 1st to 12th September
